description: What a wallet has done in Mamo, newest first: deposits, withdrawals and automatic compounding, each with amount, USD value then, tx hash and time. Pages 20 at a time: pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor`. Stocks rows include rebalances. Filter with `types`: deposit/withdraw alone carry no USD; other types scan up to 200 events per call. A new wallet returns an empty list, not an error.

address.description: The wallet address whose history to read, 0x-prefixed, on Base.

cursor.description: Pass the last result's `nextCursor`; omit it for the newest events.

limit.description: How many events to return. Default 20, maximum 40.

name: get_user_activity
title: A wallet's Mamo activity
